window_rule: rolling six calendar months ending on the UTC run date; both endpoints included; incident date (not publication date) governs

operational_settings.tvl_floor_rule: HARD floor at $50,000 per operator directive: protocols below it are identified and recorded in protocols/subfloor_authority_deferred.json but never screened or ranked.

safety_posture.scope: DefiLlama-listed protocols with documented relationship only

evidence_grades.A: deployed code/trace + official or independent technical analysis
evidence_grades.B: one strong technical source + corroborating chain evidence

expansion_pass.reason: Operator asked for a broader sweep at a $50,000 floor with additional observable conditions.
expansion_pass.condition_layer: tools/conditions.py - 24 observable conditions incl. fork-of-an-in-window-victim, dead adapter with residual TVL, version-sibling legacy, declared fallback oracle, RWA pricing surface, co-curated vaults and tag-driven architecture
expansion_pass.deployed_source_sweep: tools/source_sweep.py - static indicators evaluated against verified deployed source, cached under sources/deployments/
precision_controls: relevance gate: a guard can only read as absent if the contract actually shows a distinguishing indicator for that family
prevalence demotion: any indicator firing on more than 25% of the swept population is demoted to ordering-only
metadata-derived oracle counts never establish a code precondition or prove a guard absent
approval-dependent families keep an UNKNOWN exposure precondition because live allowances were not enumerated
